subject: CSE: Big-O notation
text: Big-O describes how running time grows with input size n. A single loop is O(n), nested loops are O(n^2), and binary search is O(log n).

subject: Civil: Stress and strain
text: Stress is force per unit area and strain is change in length per original length. In the elastic range stress equals Young's modulus times strain.

subject: Mechanical: First law of thermodynamics
text: Energy is conserved: change in internal energy equals heat added minus work done by the system.

subject: ECE: Sampling theorem
text: To rebuild a signal without aliasing, sample at more than twice its highest frequency. This is the Nyquist rate.

subject: Agriculture: Crop rotation
text: Crop rotation keeps soil fertile and breaks pest cycles. Legumes such as gram and pigeon pea fix nitrogen for the next crop.

subject: Civil services: Fundamental Rights
text: Fundamental Rights are in Part III of the Constitution, Articles 12 to 35. Article 14 guarantees equality and Article 21 protects life and personal liberty.
